description: Nestled in the heart of the picturesque village of Salem in Goa lies a hidden gem - Sal Dam Picnic Spot. This man-made marvel, built across the tranquil Sal River, offers a serene and idyllic setting for picnickers and nature enthusiasts. In this blog, we will delve into the beauty and charm of Sal Dam Picnic Spot, discovering its attractions and activities that make it a perfect getaway for families and friends. LOCATION AND OPENING HOURS: Sal Dam Picnic Spot is conveniently located in Salem, Goa. It welcomes visitors from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, making it an ideal spot for a day trip or a relaxing weekend escape. SCENIC BEAUTY AND LANDSCAPE: The star attraction of Sal Dam Picnic Spot is undoubtedly the dam itself, stretching across the Sal River. Encircled by verdant hills, this spot promises stunning vistas and a sense of tranquility that's hard to find elsewhere. ADMISSION AND FACILITIES AT SAL DAM: Entry to this natural haven is incredibly affordable, with an admission fee of just INR 5 per person. This makes it accessible to all, ensuring that everyone can enjoy its tranquil beauty. 1. Children's Play Area: Families with children will appreciate the well-maintained children's play area. It provides a safe and entertaining space for kids to expend their energy while parents relax. 2. Boating Jetty: The dam's expansive waters beckon adventure seekers. A boating jetty allows visitors to take a leisurely boat ride, soaking in the scenic beauty that surrounds them. 3. Restaurant: While there are no restaurants in the immediate vicinity, Sal Dam Picnic Spot features an on-site restaurant. It offers a range of refreshments, ensuring you won't go hungry during your visit. 4. Parking: Worried about parking? Sal Dam Picnic Spot has you covered with ample parking space for your convenience. ACTIVITIES TO ENJOY: 1. Swimming: The dam is a popular spot for a refreshing swim. However, swimmers should exercise caution, as currents can be strong. Always prioritize safety. 2. Fishing: Anglers will find the dam teeming with fish. Bring your fishing gear and try your luck at catching a variety of species. 3. Boat Rides: Enjoy a peaceful boat ride on the calm waters of the dam. It's a wonderful way to connect with nature and admire the lush greenery that surrounds you. 4. Hiking: Nature enthusiasts and hikers will love the nearby hiking trails. These trails offer breathtaking vistas of the dam and the verdant countryside. Don't forget to bring comfortable walking shoes and a sense of adventure. 5. Picnicking: Embrace the simplicity of life by packing a picnic. Spread out your blanket or towel under the shade of the trees and savor a meal amidst nature's beauty. BEST TIME TO VISIT: While Sal Dam Picnic Spot is open year-round, the best time to experience its full glory is during the monsoon season (June to September). This is when the dam is at its fullest, and the surrounding hills are dressed in lush greenery, creating a mesmerizing backdrop for your outing. Sal Dam Picnic Spot in Salem, Goa, is a haven for those seeking a peaceful escape from the hustle and bustle of city life. With its stunning dam, serene surroundings, and a host of activities, it promises a day of relaxation, adventure, and connection with nature. So, whether you're planning a family picnic or a day out with friends, don't forget to include Sal Dam Picnic Spot on your list of places to visit in Goa.
